model_visible.evidence_summary: New enterprise retrieval architecture with Pro/Fast shared embedding space, multimodality, 128k context, multilingual and Matryoshka outputs.
Execution-time temporal governance for agent actions is a distinct engineering mechanism and not present in the prior edition.
Transforms fragmented enterprise context into decision-grade knowledge with provenance, recency and human validation for people and agents.
Slack MCP Server adds create/read/update/delete operations for Lists and records; AI-assisted CRM and admin workflows reduce switching and cleanup.
Reusable modular Skills save instructions, can auto-run on matching prompts, stack together, and include reference files. Candidate for the one reusable Agent Skills story.

Distinct small-business agent expansion with skills/connectors across common business tools and explicit approval boundaries; extended fallback needed for category diversity and practical nontechnical value.
